skill.summary: Publish markdown articles to Dev.to via their REST API. Use this skill whenever the user wants to publish a blog post or article to Dev.to.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Blog Publisher Lite for Dev.to.

- Publish Markdown articles directly to Dev.to using their REST API.
- Supports extracting the title, tags, and body from standard Markdown files.
- Simple CLI for publishing as draft or live with customizable tags.
- Includes troubleshooting tips for common API errors.
- Requires a Dev.to API key for authentication.
